2. **`git reset --hard 43c1c3c`** — moves `main` forward to the "Production database config - critical" commit, effectively undoing the accidental `reset to HEAD~1`

```bash

```

If you prefer not to use a hard reset (which overwrites your working tree), you can cherry-pick the commit instead:

```bash
